adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts` the permission gate is likely incorrect: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)`, so a user must be BOTH admin and owner to pass (which can wrongly lock out legitimate team admins or owners). Also the attendee/duplicate/blacklist checks compare emails case-sensitively (`attendee.email === user.email`, `guest === attendee.email`, and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where only the blacklist is lowercased), allowing bypasses/false negatives when email casing differs. These are concrete behavioral/security defects visible in the diff, independent of the (also true) missing tests claim.
